verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜੑਹਿ ਇਕਸ ਅਖਰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh brahame vedh paR(h)h ikas akhar bhedh na jaataa|

en.bdb: Even after reading lakhs of Vedas, Brahma did not understand syllable (paramatama)

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਭੇਖੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: jog dhiaan mahes lakh roop na rekh na bhekh pachhaataa|

en.bdb: Siva meditates through lakhs of methods (postures) but still could not recognise the form, hue and guise (of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh avataar akaar kar til veechaar na bisan pachhaataa|

en.bdb: Visnu incarnated himself through lakhs of creatures but he could not recognise even a bit of that Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਉਤਨ ਨਾਉ ਲੈ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸੇਖ ਵਿਸੇਖ ਨ ਤਾਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh nautan naau lai lakh lakh sekh visekh na taataa|

en.bdb: Sesanag (the mythical snake) recited and remembered many a new name of the Lord but still could not know much about Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: chir jeevan bahu ha(n)ddane dharasan pa(n)th na sabadh sin(j)aataa|

en.bdb: Many long-lived persons experienced life variously, but they all and many a philosopher could not understand Sabda, the Brahma.
All got engrossed in the gifts of that Lord and that bestower has been forgotten.
